mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800.0 thousand units in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and overall demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.0% in a 3-month window, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equities, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
